From 5ad6fbee554da44c370eed08cd7f5a1200813a22 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Charles Dang <exodia339@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2020 13:50:24 +1100
Subject: [PATCH] Added an `auxiliary` input field to `_ksListsMeta(where: {})`

---
 .changeset/ten-balloons-begin.md            |  5 +++++
 packages/keystone/lib/providers/listCRUD.js | 12 ++++++++++--
 2 files changed, 15 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 .changeset/ten-balloons-begin.md

diff --git a/.changeset/ten-balloons-begin.md b/.changeset/ten-balloons-begin.md
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..b4f99a9a822
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.changeset/ten-balloons-begin.md
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@keystonejs/keystone': minor
+---
+
+Added an `auxiliary` input field to `_ksListsMeta(where: {})`.
diff --git a/packages/keystone/lib/providers/listCRUD.js b/packages/keystone/lib/providers/listCRUD.js
index 1cf1ffdd857..0e3796cf35d 100644
--- a/packages/keystone/lib/providers/listCRUD.js
+++ b/packages/keystone/lib/providers/listCRUD.js
@@ -92,6 +92,9 @@ class ListCRUDProvider {
       }`,
       `input ${this.gqlNames.listsMetaInput} {
         key: String
+
+        """Whether this is an auxiliary helper list."""
+        auxiliary: Boolean
       }`,
       `input _ListSchemaFieldsInput {
         type: String
@@ -191,9 +194,14 @@ class ListCRUDProvider {
       ...objMerge(firstClassLists.map(list => list.gqlQueryResolvers({ schemaName }))),
 
       // And the Keystone meta queries must always be available
-      [this.gqlNames.listsMeta]: (_, { where: { key } = {} }, context) =>
+      [this.gqlNames.listsMeta]: (_, { where: { key, auxiliary } = {} }, context) =>
         this.lists
-          .filter(list => list.access[schemaName].read && (!key || list.key === key))
+          .filter(
+            list =>
+              list.access[schemaName].read &&
+              (!key || list.key === key) &&
+              (auxiliary === undefined || list.isAuxList === auxiliary)
+          )
           .map(list => list.listMeta(context)),
     };
   }
